scripts.video: playwright test -c tests/browser/video.config.ts demo && ffmpeg -y -loglevel error -i video/angular.webm -i video/react.webm -filter_complex hstack=inputs=2 -c:v libx264 -pix_fmt yuv420p -movflags +faststart video/angular-vs-react.mp4
scripts.video:tour: playwright test -c tests/browser/video.config.ts tour && ffmpeg -y -loglevel error -i video/tour-angular.webm -i video/tour-react.webm -filter_complex hstack=inputs=2 -c:v libx264 -pix_fmt yuv420p -movflags +faststart video/tour-angular-vs-react.mp4
scripts.inventory: docker compose -f .docker/docker-compose.yml exec -T app cv scr --user=admin /var/www/html/ext/afreact/scripts/inventory.php
scripts.types: docker compose -f .docker/docker-compose.yml exec -T app cv scr --user=admin /var/www/html/ext/afreact/scripts/gen-types.php > src/api/entities.gen.ts
scripts.core-shape: docker compose -f .docker/docker-compose.yml exec -T -u www-data -e AFREACT_WRITE_CORE_SHAPE=1 -w /var/www/html/ext/afreact app vendor/bin/phpunit --filter CoreShapeHeadlessTest
